note: The player's van (Boss, 24 Oct 2026): one van at a time, part-exchanged when a new one is bought. Seven designs drawn from Boss's reference photos (art/reference/vans). length is the footprint in 64 px tiles along the heading (one tile wide), from the real length at 28 px per metre. drivable lists the ground art a van can use. starter is the van the opening chain sells and where it is parked when bought. name is the in-game name, from Boss's reference file names (the text after "Van N = "); van-1 to van-7 are only the model numbers.
